import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
palette = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=df['BMI Category'].nunique())
for i, bmi in enumerate(df['BMI Category'].unique()):
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                label=bmi, alpha=0.6, s=50, c=[palette[i]])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='lower right')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level colored by Sleep Disorder
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Fill NaN in Sleep Disorder with 'None'
df['Sleep Disorder Filled'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_palette = {'None': '#2ecc71', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c', 'Insomnia': '#3498db'}
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder Filled'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder Filled'] == disorder]
    ax2.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Stress Level'], 
                label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=50, 
                c=disorder_palette.get(disorder, '#95a5a6'))
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 3: Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette("viridis", n_colors=len(occupation_sleep))
bars = ax3.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.axvline(x=df['Sleep Duration'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', 
            label=f'Overall Mean: {df["Sleep Duration"].mean():.1f}h')
ax3.legend(loc='lower right')
for i, (val, bar) in enumerate(zip(occupation_sleep.values, bars)):
    ax3.text(val + 0.05, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.1f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 4: Distribution of Sleep Quality by Gender and Age Group
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create age groups
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[25, 35, 45, 55, 65], 
                         labels=['26-35', '36-45', '46-55', '56-65'])
# Create grouped data
grouped_data = df.groupby(['Age Group', 'Gender'])['Quality of Sleep'].mean().unstack()
x = range(len(grouped_data.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax4.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], grouped_data['Male'], width, 
                label='Male', color='#3498db', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax4.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], grouped_data['Female'], width, 
                label='Female', color='#e91e63', alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Sleep Quality by Age Group and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(grouped_data.index)
ax4.legend(title='Gender')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax4.annotate(f'{height:.1f}',
                    xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                    xytext=(0, 3),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
